description: Search public SportsTrackLive tracks (finished, stored activities), newest first. Filter by free text (locality / take-off name or athlete user name), sport name, and an ISO date range. Returns per track the athlete, sport, location, date and web page URL; feed a track_id to get_track_stats for full statistics.

query.description:
Free-text filter matched against the locality (take-off/venue) name
and the athlete's user name.
